description: Describes dataset build order and dependency relationships. References ONLY Dataset Registry IDs. Dependencies reflect logical relationships required for data integrity.

railway_divisions.notes: Each division belongs to a zone. Must be built after railway_zones.

station_codes.notes: Each station code is associated with a division. Must be built after railway_divisions.

station_master.notes: Station master records reference station code identifiers. Must be built after station_codes.

station_categories.notes: Standalone classification reference. No upstream dependencies.

station_status.notes: Status records reference station code identifiers. Must be built after station_codes.

train_master.notes: Independent dataset. No upstream dataset dependencies.

notes: Dataset dependency graph. Describes build order and upstream dependencies for each dataset. Dependencies mirror those declared in the Dataset Registry descriptors. No URLs, API endpoints, or download logic are included.
